title: Junta constant decision rule
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $a\in\mathbb Q$ be an estimate, and write $t_k$ for the junta constant threshold at $k$. If $t_k<a$, declare the constant target $+1$; otherwise, if $a<-t_k$, declare the constant target $-1$; in all other cases, declare the target nonconstant.
caveat: The threshold function is referenced but not defined in the supplied statement.
